نتوافق (form VI)
# نَتَوَافَقُ (natawāfaqu) /na.ta.waː.fa.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
# نَتَوَافَقَ (natawāfaqa) /na.ta.waː.fa.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
# نَتَوَافَقْ (natawāfaq) /na.ta.waː.faq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَافَقَ (tawāfaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
